The offline test set contains **11.8K query-level instances** involving **93K unique member profiles** (p. 6).

For context, from the same section (p. 6):
- Each test instance has one clicked candidate as the positive and three negatives, drawn from non-clicked impressions and randomly sampled members.
- The data is split by time, so all training interactions come before the test window.
- The training set is much larger: 209K query-level instances involving 4.4M unique member profiles.
